filament_notes:
SUNLU manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C.
Manufacturer max speed 400 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 24.5 mm3/s (printer profile 18) from the manufacturer's 400 mm/s rating, capped at 24.5 for this printer.
Temperature set for ~250 mm/s on this printer: 220 C (first layer 220 C). Manufacturer bands: 210-230 C at 60-150 mm/s; 230-260 C at 300-400 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Product page: 210-230C @60-150mm/s, 230-260C @300-400mm/s; marketing 'up to 600mm/s'; wiki says 210-230C / <=250mm/s (conflict). Abrasiveness not stated by SUNLU. Shore (HA/HD) 82. Wiki: fan ON, drying 50C.
Source: https://www.sunlu.com/products/high-speed-pla-marble-filament
